components.name: Navigation
components.description: Desktop floating pill; at 767px and below, an opaque bottom dock with visible destination labels and 44px targets.

components.css: .ds-nav {display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid #161616;border-radius:28px;background:#0b0b0b;box-shadow:0 8px 32px -12px rgba(128,128,128,.3);font:400 14px/1.4 var(--font-portfolio, sans-serif)}.ds-nav a {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:24px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a[aria-current],.ds-nav a:hover {background:#303030}.ds-nav a:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #8ce7f6;outline-offset:4px}.ds-nav a:active {background:#404040}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-nav{border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;padding-bottom:max(4px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));justify-content:space-around}.ds-nav a{border-radius:12px;font-size:12px}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{font-weight:600}}

components.name: Email Close
components.description: Rounded, direct mailto close with factual contact information.
components.css: .ds-close {padding:40px;border:1px solid var(--neutral-border-weak,#161616);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface-background,#101010);color:var(--neutral-on-background-strong,#fff);text-align:center;font:400 16px/1.6 var(--font-portfolio,sans-serif)}.ds-close h2 {margin:0 0 20px;font-size:36px}.ds-close a {display:inline-flex;min-height:48px;align-items:center;color:var(--brand-on-background-strong,#8ce7f6);font-size:28px}.ds-close a:hover {color:var(--neutral-on-background-strong,#fff)}.ds-close a:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--brand-on-background-strong,#8ce7f6);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Contact Service
components.description: Descriptive bordered social link, paired in columns on desktop and stacked on phones.
components.css: .ds-contact {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:64px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--neutral-alpha-medium,#303030);border-radius:16px;color:var(--neutral-on-background-strong,#fff);background:var(--page-background,#0b0b0b);text-decoration:none;font:400 16px/1.3 var(--font-portfolio,sans-serif)}.ds-contact svg {flex-shrink:0}.ds-contact span {display:grid;gap:2px;min-width:0}.ds-contact strong {font-size:16px}.ds-contact small {color:var(--neutral-on-background-weak,#b2b2b2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.4}.ds-contact:hover {background:var(--neutral-alpha-weak,#242424);color:var(--brand-on-background-strong,#8ce7f6)}.ds-contact:active {background:var(--neutral-alpha-medium,#303030)}.ds-contact:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--brand-on-background-strong,#8ce7f6);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The public site adapts Once UI's Magic Portfolio, selected by Steven to replace the flat Quiet Studio direction. A centered personal introduction, floating navigation, rounded controls, soft cyan atmosphere, and theme-aware surfaces make the site feel like a professional home rather than an application dashboard. Existing factual content and real photography remain the subject.
keyCharacteristics: Self-hosted IBM Plex Sans and a clear display-to-body hierarchy.
Dark by default, with a persistent light-theme control.
Cyan for links, focus, and atmosphere.
Rounded photographs and selective surfaces, balanced with bare reading sections.
A desktop navigation pill that becomes a persistent mobile bottom dock.
A completely separate Windows 95 experience at `/desktop`.

rules.name: The Two-World Rule
rules.body: Public styling and theme state stay inside the portfolio boundary. Never apply Once UI's element resets or theme attributes to the Windows 95 desktop.

dos: Do use Once UI primitives and semantic theme variables for public components.
Do preserve factual content, deep links, metadata, and the full photography library.
Do maintain readable contrast in both themes, including tinted surfaces.
Do keep the photography library on `/photos`; the small shared profile photograph is the homepage's only photographic asset.
Do keep LinkedIn, GitHub, and X profile links prominent in the homepage hero, with accessible icon-only controls.
Do keep the Windows 95 desktop functional and stylistically isolated.
donts: Don't restore the obsolete flat-only Quiet Studio restrictions.
Don't turn the site into a dashboard or add template demo content, a blog, or a newsletter without a content requirement.
Don't promote repository projects on the homepage or resume, or add GitHub links to the resume.
Don't invent professional claims, testimonials, customers, or outcomes.
Don't set shared root theme attributes or import unscoped Once UI element resets.
